## fromWireErrorEnvelope() function

Reconstruct the canonical error from an error response body.

**Signature:**


The reconstructed error.

## Remarks

The class comes from `body.error.code` through the registry, never from the HTTP status. A body that is not an envelope, an unknown code, a non-string message, or details that fail the code's schema yield a [TransportError](./contracts.transporterror.md) with reason `'protocol-mismatch'`<!-- -->. `receivedCode` is attached only when the received code was a string, truncated to a bounded length. The returned error has no `cause`<!-- -->.
